note: Values may exceed 100% when children who are older or younger than the official age group also enroll.
title: Share of children enrolled in primary school
subtitle: Shown as the [gross enrollment ratio](#dod:gross-enrolment-ratio) — the number of children, regardless of their age, who are enrolled in [primary](#dod:primary-education) education, expressed as a percentage of the population of primary school age (between 5 and 7 years old).
